InjecAgent.notes: Converted DS base cases contain three derived hops. Original source labels are preserved.

AgentDojo.notes: Execution/run records represent trajectories. Individual run files must not automatically be counted as independent benchmark samples.

ASB.notes: Attack-tool definitions and normal-tool definitions are not themselves attack sessions. Actual executable evaluation/task records must be identified before conversion.

BIPIA.notes: Available records contain indirect-injection benchmark contexts/questions. Do not represent static records as genuine agent trajectories.

PINT.notes: Local repository does not contain the full published benchmark. Do not claim the published total as locally available.

global_rules: Do not duplicate samples to reach a target count.
Do not treat tool definitions as attack sessions.
Keep provenance for every converted sample.
Do not mix related variants across train and test when this creates leakage.
